messages.author: 6794969ce0cf57b0
messages.subject: Style guide suggestions for UI.R?
parts:
Hi all,

I was wondering if anyone has a recommended style guide or tips for keeping the ui.R script neat and easily readable?

Personally, I find that as my apps get more complicated it becomes hard/tedious to keep track and manage of the code in the ui.R file.

In contrast, the server.R file is very straight forward to manage and to understand because of the clear style guidelines and automatic formating available in R. For example one can collapse functions or automatically re-indent the code (via Code -> Reindent lines in the RStudio app). There is even a wonderful package called formatR that can take messy code and clean it up for you (http://yihui.name/formatR/)

Any suggestions greatly appreciated

Cheers,

Iain

block 1

I also add # end of function_name at the ends of long functions. Look below for example.
Aside from that, keep your indentation style consistent

EX: (I don't really need #---------------------- in this one, but they can be useful in longer or more convoluted ui.R.
shinyUI(
  fluidPage(
     titlePanel(),
  
     sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
           textInput(),
           textInput(),
           textInput(),

           uiOutput("chooseDatabases")
                    ), #sidebarPanel() end parantheses

        mainPanel(
           tabsetPanel(
                  tabPanel("",
